description: Search the EUIPO's harmonised Locarno product-indications classification (DSClass) used for registered Community design filings — "find accepted design indications for 'chair'". Returns matching indications with their Locarno class/subclass and concept id, plus raw. Example: euipo_search_product_indications({ term: "chair", locarno_class: 6, language: "en" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own EUIPO client_id:client_secret; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

language.description: EU official language code for the search and results, e.g. "en". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

locarno_class.description: Locarno classification class number to restrict the search to, e.g. 6.

parent_concept_id.description: Restrict to children of this taxonomy concept id (for browsing the classification tree).

term.description: Text to search for within product-indication terms, e.g. "chair".

name: euipo_search_product_indications
title: Euipo Search Product Indications
